title: The Clockwork Train
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The midnight clockwork train runs through the village of Copperwell once a year, and ten-year-old Ada has never missed it — until the year it stops, and the conductor steps off to ask her for help. The train\'s clockwork heart has stopped, and the only one who can wind it is a child who still believes in the timetable.
